label: Scenario 4 · WALLX
title: Scenario 4: right arm picks the Bhindi box, hands it to the left arm in the air, WALLX puts it into zone 1

steps.title: Read the label and route the parcel
steps.detail: Code 420/95126/001 = ZIP 951 → blue lane → zone 1 (left). The harness tries the QR, then the printed ZIP; this run used the preset demo code for the Bhindi box (source 'demo').
steps.what: label → lane → acting arm → target zone

steps.title: Recorded pick + handover (Ayush's controller demo, smoothed)
steps.detail: Replays our own teleop recording of scenario 4 (first 59 s, 32 trajectory rows per call): right arm picks, hands to the left claw in the air.

sub.text: right arm moves from home to above the box (claw closed)
right claw opens and lowers around the box
right claw closes on the box (grasp)
right arm lifts the box to the handover point (~18 cm up, table centre)
left claw opens and reaches in
left claw closes on the box: both claws hold it
right claw opens: the box is in the left claw only

steps.title: Right arm backs off
steps.detail: Scripted slow move (≤ 4 cm per call): right claw lifts and moves away to (0.35, 0.20, 0.26) m so it cannot hit the box or the left arm.

steps.title: Right arm goes home
steps.detail: Scripted slow move to home, claw closed. From here the right arm stays parked.

steps.title: WALLX places the box into zone 1 (left arm)
steps.prompt: Stretch to the top left corner of the table and put the purple box into zone 1.
steps.detail: WALLX (wall-x 2610-dualhead-v2, organisers' server) gets the HEAD camera image (the harness sends black wrist images: the held box blocks the left wrist camera, so it only confuses WALLX) + both arms' state + this sentence every call, and returns an action chunk for both arms. The harness LOCKS the right arm (its WALLX actions are replaced by 'hold still'), runs 40% of each chunk per call (--slow 0.4, smoother and safer), and keeps the same sub-goal across calls (--no-reset-on-subgoal). 40 calls. WALLX alone decides where to move, how to lower and where to set the box down.

steps.title: Release
steps.detail: Scripted: the left claw opens fully where WALLX left it, then lifts 8 cm straight up, so the box stays inside zone 1.

steps.title: Both arms home
steps.detail: Scripted slow move of both arms to home (≤ 5 cm per call).

steps.title: Done
steps.detail: Session ends; video, every call (state, actions, images) and the log are saved.
